name: Coyote Huntin'
summary: Benjy Wheeler asks you to deal with Sootfur, the dark-furred leader of a coyote pack west of the river. The coyotes have turned to eating horses after murlocs drove them from their usual fishing ground.

sections.title: A Threat to the Horses
sections.body: Benjy Wheeler says the coyotes once hunted fish along the shore, but murlocs drove them from that feeding ground. Now the pack has taken to eating horses. Its leader is a larger, dark-furred coyote called Sootfur. Benjy asks you to bring back Sootfur's pelt, hoping the rest of the pack will scatter.

sections.title: Benjy's Stables
sections.body: When you return with Sootfur's pelt, Benjy says the coyote had been rooting around in his stables. He thanks you and says he expects the horses to be safe when the stables are running again.

faq.answer: Sootfur is the larger, dark-furred leader of the coyote pack west of the river.

faq.q: Why are the coyotes eating horses?
faq.answer: Murlocs pushed the coyotes away from their usual fishing ground along the shore, so they began eating horses.
Benjy Wheeler asks you to bring him Sootfur's pelt.
The pack lives in a den west of Benjy's location, across the river.
